name: Silvia Rivera Cusicanqui
shortBio: Bolivian Aymara-descended sociologist, historian, and decolonial theorist who developed ch'ixi epistemology—a mottled coexistence of unassimilated Indigenous and Western worlds—while critiquing academic "decoloniality" elites.
centralQuestion: How can ch'ixi—holding irreconcilable Indigenous and colonial contradictions in productive tension without false mestizaje synthesis—ground genuine decolonization?

keyWorks.title: Ch'ixinakax utxiwa: On Practices and Discourses of Decolonization
keyWorks.description: Formulates ch'ixi decoloniality and internal colonialism while indicting Northern academic co-optation of Latin American decolonial thought.

keyWorks.title: Oppressed but Not Defeated: Peasant Struggles Among the Aymara and Quechua in Bolivia
keyWorks.description: Sociological historiography of Andean anti-colonial rebellions and long/short historical memory.
